Bash(git -C "D:\\projects\\gym-management-saas" commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
perf\(auth\): remove synchronous cache clear on login

Performance Optimization:
- Remove queryClient.clear\(\) call from login flow
- This operation synchronously clears ALL cached queries, causing 3-4 second delays
- React Query automatically handles stale data when navigating to protected pages
- Each dashboard page will fetch fresh data naturally

Why This Change:
- queryClient.clear\(\) is a blocking operation that clears entire cache synchronously
- Completely unnecessary on login since:
  1. React Query invalidates stale queries automatically
  2. Protected pages fetch fresh data when mounted
  3. No previous user data to worry about during login
  
Expected Impact:
- Login should now be nearly instantaneous \(< 500ms\)
- Improved user experience with faster authentication
